title: My Stepson Forged My Release, Locked Me Out, And Stole $700K. So I Garnished His Wages.
description: After my husband died, I used his rare coin collection to start a dealership with my stepson. He sold a 1913 Liberty Head nickel for $700,000, forged my signature, and locked me out. Now he polishes coins for minimum wage while his deposition plays on a loop and the court garnishes his pay. #ProRevenge #Numismatics #JusticeServed
thumb_text: HIS DEPOSITION LIES PLAY ON LOOP WHILE HE POLISHES COINS
pinned_comment: What would you do if your stepson forged your release, sold a $700K nickel, and locked you out of the dealership you inherited from your late husband? I sued and garnished his wages, would you have done the same? Share your story in the comments.
